entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: ¶The wise sayings of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: To have knowledge of wise teaching; to be clear about the words of reason:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: To be trained in the ways of wisdom, in righteousness and judging truly and straight behaviour:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: To make the simple-minded sharp, and to give the young man knowledge, and serious purpose:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: (The wise man, hearing, will get greater learning, and the acts of the man of good sense will be wisely guided:)

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: To get the sense of wise sayings and secrets, and of the words of the wise and their dark sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: ¶The fear of the Lord is the start of knowledge: but the foolish have no use for wisdom and teaching.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: My son, give ear to the training of your father, and do not give up the teaching of your mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: For they will be a crown of grace for your head, and chain-ornaments about your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: ¶My son, if sinners would take you out of the right way, do not go with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, Come with us; let us make designs against the good, waiting secretly for the upright, without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: Let us overcome them living, like the underworld, and in their strength, as those who go down to death;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: Goods of great price will be ours, our houses will be full of wealth;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: Take your chance with us, and we will all have one money-bag:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: My son, do not go with them; keep your feet from their ways:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: For their feet are running after evil, and they are quick to take a man's life.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: Truly, to no purpose is the net stretched out before the eyes of the bird:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: And they are secretly waiting for their blood and making ready destruction for themselves.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: Such is the fate of everyone who goes in search of profit; it takes away the life of its owners.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: ¶Wisdom is crying out in the street; her voice is loud in the open places;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: Her words are sounding in the meeting-places, and in the doorways of the town:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: How long, you simple ones, will foolish things be dear to you? and pride a delight to the haters of authority? how long will the foolish go on hating knowledge?

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Be turned again by my sharp words: see, I will send the flow of my spirit on you, and make my words clear to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because your ears were shut to my voice; no one gave attention to my out-stretched hand;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: You were not controlled by my guiding, and would have nothing to do with my sharp words:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: So in the day of your trouble I will be laughing; I will make sport of your fear;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: When your fear comes on you like a storm, and your trouble like a rushing wind; when pain and sorrow come on you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: Then I will give no answer to their cries; searching for me early, they will not see me:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: For they were haters of knowledge, and did not give their hearts to the fear of the Lord:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: They had no desire for my teaching, and my words of protest were as nothing to them.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: So the fruit of their way will be their food, and with the designs of their hearts they will be made full.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the turning back of the simple from teaching will be the cause of their death, and the peace of the foolish will be their destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoever gives ear to me will take his rest safely, living in peace without fear of evil.
